gotchas: Atmos Rewards (formerly Mileage Plan) join form, single page, at https://www.alaskaair.com/atmosrewards/enroll; reached from the header 'Sign-in or Profile' menu -> 'Sign up now'. /account/signup is a 404. A cookie banner ('Accept all' / 'Refuse all') shows on load.
Fields are Auro web components (auro-input / auro-button) in shadow DOM; plain button selectors miss the submit, use auro-button:has-text("Join Atmos Rewards").

Required beyond name/email/password: Gender (custom combobox), Date of birth (Month combobox + Day/Year spinbuttons), phone (country code combobox + input[name="phoneNumber"]; no phone token, type a synthetic number), and a full mailing address (Country, Address line 1, Zip, City, State combobox). Middle name, suffix and preferred airport are optional.

User ID: email or a 7+ character ID with at least 1 letter, no spaces or symbols. Password: 8+ characters with 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase and 1 number. There are two input[type="password"] on the page, so target input[name="password"].
A Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise frame (www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise/anchor) is loaded on the page; whether it challenges on submit was not tested.
The marketing email checkbox is pre-checked.
Inputs inside Auro hosts are hidden until the host is clicked: click auro-input:has(input[name="<name>"]) then fill the input.
Gender and DOB Month are comboboxes whose options are auro-menuoption elements (role=option by name does not match): click the combobox, then auro-menuoption:has-text("Female") >> visible=true.
State combobox accepts typed text: fill the state token into role=combobox[name*="State"], then click the single visible option.
Phone wants the national number (country code is a separate combobox defaulting to +1); an E.164 value leaves the field invalid.
A failed submit leaves the invalid host with a validity attribute other than 'valid': [validity]:not([validity="valid"]).
